name: promised-later
about: Billing opens a review and promises a corrected statement; nothing is fixed on the call (offline reading).

asks.text: Apply your insurance: the statement says you owe $1,100, not $8,700

rep_lines: Patient Financial Services, this is Diane, how can I help you?
